title: Tahoe Lakeview Snowmobiling Tours
blurb: Your scenic Lakeview Tour is a two-hour, guided, scenery-focused adventure that will take you on a journey through majestic pine and aspen trees. Your expert guides will lead you as you glide across mountain meadows to peaks nearly 9,000 feet high. Enjoy the spectacular views of the Lake Tahoe Basin from the top of the mountain. Each tour is designed to stop at various locations for stunning photo opportunities, while capturing the beauty of nature. This tour is available every day with departures in the morning, at noon, and in the afternoon. During full moons, you can enjoy a perfect evening ride under the moonlight.
